verdict.rationale: Baseten's hosted Model APIs are documented only for language models, so non-text models are not available as ready-to-call endpoints. Truss does support deploying `diffusers` and arbitrary PyTorch/TensorFlow models as endpoints on the same platform, which implies image generation and other modalities are possible if you deploy them yourself. Missing for 10: hosted vision, audio, or image-generation endpoints; explicit docs or examples for vision or audio models; independent corroboration of multimodal use.
